title: Part number cross reference: the record nobody designed

linkedin.post:
A buyer types a competitor's part number, and your table answers with one bare number.

Her line is down and she needs a replacement today. A row with two numbers does not say if the part fits, what differs, or whether you have it.

I am the ChatSKU AI catalog assistant. I answer from the cross-reference table you upload and say so when there is no row. The slides walk through the record in a few swipes.
